description: Compare exactly two fragrances side by side using ScentVerdict's own note data: which notes they share, which differ, both verdicts, and both prices for the user's country. Use this whenever the user is choosing between two named fragrances, or asks which of two is better, or how two differ. Use find_similar_fragrances instead when they want alternatives to one fragrance rather than a head to head.

country.description: The user's country as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, for example US, DE or GB. Prices are for this country, in the shop's own currency. Pass it whenever you know where the user is. When omitted, the client's location hint is used if it sent one, otherwise GB.

name: compare_fragrances

concentration.description: Concentration, for example Edt, Edp or Parfum. Null when unknown.

imageUrl.description: Bottle image URL. Null when we hold no image.

keyNotes.description: The most characteristic notes. May be empty.

price.description: Cheapest full-size bottle for the user's country, in the shop's own currency. Excludes samples and decants. Null when we hold no bottle price a shop will sell to that country.

amount.description: The bottle price, in Currency. This is the shop's own price, never a conversion.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of Amount, for example GBP, USD or EUR. The shop's own currency.

estimate.description: Rough value of Amount in the user's currency, at a published reference rate. Present only when Currency differs from the user's currency and a recent rate exists. For orientation only: never use it to rank, compare or filter prices.

amount.description: The price converted to Currency, in whole units. Approximate.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the user's currency.

rateDate.description: Date of the reference rate used, as YYYY-MM-DD. The European Central Bank's rate, or Frankfurter's for a currency the ECB does not publish.

excludesTax.description: True when the shop quotes this price before sales tax, as US shops do. Say so when you quote it.

fromAbroad.description: True when no shop in the user's own customs area sells a bottle, so this is the cheapest bottle from a shop in another country that delivers to them.

importChargesMayApply.description: True when the user may have to pay import charges on top of Amount. Say 'import charges may apply' when you quote it.

pricePerMl.description: Amount divided by SizeMl, in Currency. USE THIS to compare value between fragrances priced in the same currency, never the bottle price - a small bottle can look cheap while costing far more per millilitre. Null when the size is unknown.

shipsFrom.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country the shop sells from, for example GB or US.

sizeMl.description: Bottle size in millilitres that Amount applies to. 0 means the shop did not state a size.

scentArtUrl.description: ScentArt visual URL, generated from this fragrance's own composition. Null when not yet rendered.

slug.description: Stable identifier. Pass this to other tools.

url.description: Canonical page URL, carrying the interactive scent wheel, drydown timeline and full descriptor profile.

verdict.description: The full ScentVerdict editorial verdict. Null when this row came from a source that carries no verdict.

verdictBadge.description: Editorial classification: Favourite, Statement or Acquired. Null when not yet classified.

yearLaunched.description: Year first launched. Null when unknown.

concentration.description: Concentration, for example Edt, Edp or Parfum. Null when unknown.

imageUrl.description: Bottle image URL. Null when we hold no image.

keyNotes.description: The most characteristic notes. May be empty.

price.description: Cheapest full-size bottle for the user's country, in the shop's own currency. Excludes samples and decants. Null when we hold no bottle price a shop will sell to that country.

scentArtUrl.description: ScentArt visual URL, generated from this fragrance's own composition. Null when not yet rendered.

slug.description: Stable identifier. Pass this to other tools.

url.description: Canonical page URL, carrying the interactive scent wheel, drydown timeline and full descriptor profile.

verdict.description: The full ScentVerdict editorial verdict. Null when this row came from a source that carries no verdict.

verdictBadge.description: Editorial classification: Favourite, Statement or Acquired. Null when not yet classified.

yearLaunched.description: Year first launched. Null when unknown.

comparisonUrl.description: Canonical URL of the comparison page.

error.description: Set when the comparison could not be completed.

market.description: The country the prices in this result are for, its currency, and how it was chosen.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country the prices are for, for example GB, US or DE.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of that country's currency. Budgets are read in this currency.

source.description: How the country was chosen: 'argument' (the country you passed), 'clientHint' (the client's location hint), or 'default' (GB, used when neither was given - ask the user for their country if it matters).

notFound.description: Set when either fragrance is not in the catalogue.
Always true. The requested fragrance is not in the catalogue.

suggestions.description: Close catalogue entries the user may have meant. May be empty. Never treat these as the answer without confirming.

concentration.description: Concentration, for example Edt or Edp. Null when unknown.

slug.description: Stable identifier. Pass this to other tools.

yearLaunched.description: Year first launched. Null when unknown.
